whatIEnjoy: Designing websites and solving small coding puzzles
whatIveTried: A personal website, a group project, and a small quiz game

items.title: My First Website
items.description: Created a personal website with a home page, an about page and a contact form.

reflection.whatIDid: Built the pages and styled them with Bootstrap.
reflection.whatILearned: How to make a page look good on both desktop and mobile.
reflection.challenge: The layout broke on small phone screens.
reflection.nextStep: Improve the design and add more content.

items.title: Quiz Game
items.description: Made a small quiz game that shows one question at a time and counts the score.

reflection.whatIDid: Wrote the question list and the code that checks each answer.
reflection.whatILearned: How to use arrays and functions to keep code short.
reflection.challenge: Keeping the score correct when the user clicks quickly.
reflection.nextStep: Add a timer and a high score list.
